name: Community IX Holdings
notes:
Community IX operates redundant route servers under AS63221 at FL-IX, CIX-ATL and CIX-NoVA. Route servers preserve members’ AS paths and next hops; traffic flows directly between members.

Route-server guidance:
https://www.communityix.org/policies-and-procedures/#route-servers

FL-IX
AS-SET: ARIN::AS63221:AS-FL-IX-RS
Looking Glass: https://my.fl-ix.net/lg/
Technical Guide: https://www.communityix.org/fl-ix-technical-specifications/

CIX-ATL
AS-SET: ARIN::AS63221:AS-CIX-ATL-RS
Looking Glass: https://atl.communityix.org/lg/
Technical Guide: https://www.communityix.org/cix-atl-technical-specifications/

CIX-NoVA
AS-SET: ARIN::AS63221:AS-CIX-NOVA-RS
Looking Glass: https://nova.communityix.org/lg/
Technical Guide: https://www.communityix.org/cix-nova-technical-specifications/

Combined AS-SET for all markets:
ARIN::AS63221:AS-COMMUNITYIX-RS

Market AS-SETs update automatically hourly from configured route-server membership and members’ published AS cones. Append -V4 or -V6 to a market’s AS-SET name for its address-family variant. These sets describe configured membership, rather than live BGP session state or an exact list of accepted prefixes.

AS112 DNS service is available separately through optional bilateral sessions with AS112. AS112 service routes are not distributed through the route servers. See each market’s technical guide for activation instructions.
